name: The Price of Good Fortune
description:
Rowan distrusts the name of this charm. The cleric who sells it insists the protection is what matters.

Develop cleric trades. The local End Remastered configuration enables this trading source. Earn End Remastered's evil eye advancement by obtaining the eye. This record keeps working after you use the eye. Eyes are never consumed by this quest. Loot can be random; choose other routes for the portal if a source proves elusive.
